sequence.py: Zuìjìn, nǐ chī guā le ma?

sequence.cn: 别误会，这里的瓜，不是真的西瓜。
sequence.py: Bié wùhuì, zhèlǐ de guā, bú shì zhēn de xīguā.
sequence.en: Don't get me wrong — the melon here isn't a real watermelon.

sequence.cn: 吃瓜，是指在旁边看热闹，看别人的八卦。
sequence.py: Chī guā, shì zhǐ zài pángbiān kàn rènao, kàn biéren de bāguà.
sequence.en: 吃瓜 means watching the excitement from the sidelines — following other people's gossip.

sequence.cn: 小美是公司里的"吃瓜"高手。
sequence.py: Xiǎo Měi shì gōngsī lǐ de "chī guā" gāoshǒu.
sequence.en: Xiao Mei is the office's "melon-eating" master.

sequence.cn: 谁和谁吵架了，谁又谈恋爱了，她全都知道。
sequence.py: Shéi hé shéi chǎojià le, shéi yòu tán liàn'ài le, tā quándōu zhīdào.
sequence.en: Who fought with whom, who started dating — she knows it all.

sequence.cn: 每天午休，她就搬个小板凳，准备"吃瓜"。
sequence.py: Měitiān wǔxiū, tā jiù bān gè xiǎo bǎndèng, zhǔnbèi "chī guā".
sequence.en: Every lunch break, she pulls up a little stool, ready to "eat melon".

sequence.cn: 有一天，同事们围在一起吃瓜，聊得特别开心。
sequence.py: Yǒu yìtiān, tóngshìmen wéi zài yìqǐ chī guā, liáo de tèbié kāixīn.
sequence.en: One day, coworkers gathered around to eat melon, chatting away happily.

sequence.cn: 小美凑过去一听——原来大家聊的八卦，主角是她自己！
sequence.py: Xiǎo Měi còu guòqù yì tīng—— yuánlái dàjiā liáo de bāguà, zhǔjué shì tā zìjǐ!
sequence.en: Xiao Mei leaned in to listen — turns out the gossip everyone was sharing was about her!

sequence.cn: 所以说，吃瓜一时爽，但有时候，你也会变成别人的瓜。
sequence.py: Suǒyǐ shuō, chī guā yìshí shuǎng, dàn yǒu shíhou, nǐ yě huì biànchéng biéren de guā.
sequence.en: So, eating melon feels great for a moment — but sometimes, you become someone else's melon too.
